intro: This quest represents the final culmination of the campaign against the forces within Blackrock Mountain. After reporting to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in Stormwind Keep, heroes are directed to the Valley of Heroes where Field Marshal Stonebridge coordinates a public commemoration at the city gates for all the Alliance to see.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Go to the Valley of Heroes and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Choose your reward, let the celebration begin!
